question: A bus goes from city P to Q in 45 minutes, covering a distance of 60 km, and comes back to city P with a speed of 40 km/hr. The average speed of the bus in the journey is _____ km/hr (correct to two decimal places).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed from P to Q (S₁) = Distance ÷ Time = 60 ÷ (45/60) = 80 km/hr.

Speed from Q to P (S₂) = 40 km/hr.

Since the distances covered are equal, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

Average Speed = (2 × 80 × 40) ÷ (80 + 40) = 6400 ÷ 120

Average Speed = 160 ÷ 3 = 53.33 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 53.33 km/hr.**
